quotes_verbatim_from_frozen_head: A single credible, applicable failing check is enough to REJECT even if not every declared check was run.
But a failure seen in a stale run, in an artifact linked to a different patch, or in an inapplicable log is NOT grounds to reject THIS patch.
the bar to ACCEPT is complete, fresh, linked, failure-free success
do not REJECT merely because evidence is stale/mismatched/incomplete.
abstaining on a decisive applicable failure or on complete success is an error.
